notes:
Patch 0.1.1

Online
- The Online menu shows how many other players are on listed and LAN hosts.
- While you host, the corner overlay shows how many other people are in this session.

Playtest
- Play Offline keeps your character on this machine.
- Hosted play still ends when the host closes. There is no public shard yet.

Updates
- Opening Online fetches these notes from the public patch list on the website, and from any LAN host listing.
- A notes-only publish does not replace Manafall.exe. To get a new Windows program, download it again from the website, or wait until a client zip is published on the patch list.
